title: AI Integrity: A New Paradigm for Verifiable AI Governance
reasoning: The paper introduces the PRISM framework for measuring 'AI Integrity,' which centers on verifying the reasoning process behind an AI's normative and value-based judgments. It explicitly utilizes the Schwartz Basic Human Values framework as a core component to evaluate and benchmark the 'Normative Authority' (moral and ethical values) of AI systems, particularly Large Language Models.
